SETTINGS.TITLE: Conversations Panel
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Set how long before a conversation goes from green to orange and to red. Time counts from the customer's last unanswered message. Who can see the panel is set in the Custom Role (permission "See the Conversations Panel"); administrators always can.
SETTINGS.RED_HINT: Beyond that the conversation turns red.
SETTINGS.LIST_LIMIT_HELP: How many conversations each card shows when opened.
SETTINGS.SOUND: Play a sound when a conversation enters red (each person can turn it on or off in the panel)
